assumptions.statement: The official overall-design boundary provided in provisional_boundaries.geojson is used verbatim; its exact coverage could not be re-verified because the qualification-review attachment download requires a password.
assumptions.impact: All metrics (site_area_sqm=11412825.386, green_ratio=0.265333, public_space_ratio=0.041596, building footprints) are computed from this provisional boundary and are reproducible from geometry/*.geojson.

assumptions.statement: The three key areas (zuozhuyuan 左侧园/原五道口、智源加速区 智源园区、大钟寺聚核) use the provided provisional key-area polygons; they are for design discussion and self-check only, never as official redlines or precise-area bases.
assumptions.impact: Key-area area figures in the proposal are indicative; spatial_review flags KEY_AREA_PROVISIONAL as minor.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (control-detailed planning), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: No authoritative building footprint or floor-area data exists for the site; the 56 building blocks (BLDG-0001..0056, total footprint 897608.888 m2, capped at 7 storeys) are design intent, not survey data.
assumptions.impact: Floor area ratio is unknown (reason recorded in metrics.json); building totals must not be used as statutory evidence.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines and the municipal network beyond the submitted roads.json alignments are not officially available; the 9 proposed road segments (ROAD-001..009) including the greenway and 5 pedestrian streets are design proposals.
assumptions.impact: Mobility capacity checks require confirmed redlines before implementation; traffic simulation is out of scope.

assumptions.statement: Phasing (PHASE-001 原点社区, PHASE-002 智源加速区, PHASE-003 大钟寺聚核) follows the announcement's three-stage implementation logic and assumes developer/land-ownership availability at each stage.
assumptions.impact: Implementation sequence is a design proposition; land acquisition and financing are outside this package.

assumptions.statement: Every reported metric is reproducible from geometry/*.geojson (and metrics.json) using the element five-tuple boundary-layer-formula-confidence-assumption recorded in the metrics documentation.
assumptions.impact: Independent re-computation is expected to match spatial_review.py output within floating-point tolerance.
